text:
maria: VerdantCare POC — ready to schedule perf run. They want 500 qps sustained, 2x bursts to 1500 for up to 5m, p95 <150ms on 512 tokens. Also BYOK (customer KMS) + in-transit TLS. Need: load plan, pricing delta for burst, and security sign-off. Can we run Wed 10-11am PT?
ajay: Quick Qs — which model (ft/large) and avg/outlier sequence length? quantized or fp16? these change p95 a lot.
maria: They want our recommended model for chat prompts (approx 1.2k params style, target 512 max but average 280 tokens). Prefer quantized if it doesn't jump latency >15%.
tara: Ok. Plan suggestion: smoke at 50 qps, ramp to 500 over 8m, hold 30m, then do 3x burst windows (5m each) to 1500 with 15m cooldowns. Canary route to dedicated pool with fallback to hosted smaller model if SLOs break. I can run smoke Wed.
ajay: For hardware, Dedicated A100x1-per-core should hit that p95 with q8 quant; with fp16 you'll be safer on tails. If they insist on BYOK, there's ~2-3% added latency in the KMS handshake path for first calls — KV cache avoids repeated KMS.
kevin: Pricing ask from customer: how much extra for burst (they want to budget). rough delta?
ajay: Rough: sustained @500 qps on dedicated ~= baseline monthly commit. Burst to 1500 using burst credits/ephemeral capacity — estimate +35-45% token cost during bursts depending on hit rate. I'll prepare a short calc.
riley: On KMS: need their key policy allowing our service principal, and a network ACL if they want to restrict egress. Also confirm if BYOK is regional (we can only access keys in same cloud region for perf).
maria: noted. can we include multi-az failover? customer requires cross-az recovery for 99.9% availability.
tara: Multi-AZ is doable but adds ~10-20ms median because of routing. Tradeoff: single-az + faster p95 vs multi-az + higher tail. Recommend run both in the POC and show numbers.
loadbot: perf-test job queued: verdantcare-wed-10am (id: ft-499999). will auto-post results to this thread.
ajay: Load generator snippet (wrk/vegeta) I'm planning to run for the smoke:
```
# vegeta target template
echo "GET /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{\"model\":\"redwood-chat-recommend\",\"input\":\"<sample prompt>\"}" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=500 -duration=30m | vegeta report -type=json > smoke_report.json
```
kevin: Thanks. for pricing I need a one-pager number the CSM can show — rough is fine.
ajay: I'll post a quick cost sketch after smoke. Also will include a fallback policy: if p95 >250ms for 2m, switch to fallback smaller model automatically.
riley: Ops runbook snippet (for whoever runs the test):
- slot: wed 10-11am PT
- rollback: disable burst, route all traffic to fallback model
- contact: #eng-oncall, escalate to ajay then riley
- postmortem: collect traces + kv-cache hit rates + kernel selection logs

maria: Perfect. Tara, can you confirm client's KMS contact + approval? Kevin, will you confirm the budget threshold to trigger burst commit?
tara: I'll sync with their security lead today and post the KMS ARN here. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll confirm budget by EOD. :eyes:
maria: Great — if everyone is aligned I'll schedule the run and attach the pre-run checklist here. Thanks all.
